purpose: Two multi-line paragraphs that wrap; exercises line breaking, justification and paragraph skip.
notes: LaTeX justifies and hyphenates; FlashTeX is ragged-right and greedy, so word x deltas grow along each line.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
